speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you, and when did your fever and headache first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or notice a decrease in fetal movement? Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea since eating the ice cream?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you consumed any unpasteurized dairy products or soft cheeses recently, as this raises suspicion for listeriosis? I will also check your vital signs and perform a focused physical exam.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture
REQUEST TEST: Listeria monocytogenes PCR

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium. Listeria monocytogenes PCR: Results not available in provided data.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are highly specific for Listeria monocytogenes. Given your pregnancy and recent consumption of potentially contaminated dairy, this confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
